title: Keep trace-only boot archival distinct from interrupted-turn recovery
outcome: When boot encounters retained unadmitted active-trace custody on a non-running session, its diagnostic and status describe observation archival rather than inventing an interrupted provider turn.
acceptance: Establish or exclude the reachable non-running retained-trace case through existing lifecycle/recovery owners; record the evidence and keep the background Stop-failure path as a hypothesis until proven.

If the case is supported, existing boot recovery preserves exact trace facts and uses truthful observation-only wording/status without weakening running-turn recovery; relevant regression and standard review/gate cover the fix.
